subject: [PATCH v5 13/19] selftests/mm: cover a shared-source collapse write race

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau
reviews.summary: Addressed two issues flagged by Sashiko: closing sync[0] to prevent fd leak and handling wstatus correctly in case waitpid() fails.

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch series adds a selftest to cover a shared-source collapse write race in the kernel. The test checks that CoW isolation survives a collapse racing with writes to the shared source by having the parent unshare one page every 10ms while the child collapses. This is preparation for changing how collapse handles fork-shared sources.
